SBI CBO Final Result 2026 Out @sbi.bank.in

The SBI CBO Result is for the recruitment of Circle Based Officers (CBO). The final result pdf has been uploaded with the roll numbers of all the candidates who have been shortlisted on provisional basis on the basis of their performance in Online Test and Interview. The selection is subject to qualifying the Local Language Proficiency Test and satisfying all the eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification. The candidates who have qualified will be appointed as Circle Based Officers and final posting location will be decided by the Bank. They should regularly check the official SBI website for further joining and appointment updates.

SBI CBO Final Result PDF Download Link

The SBI CBO Result 2026 PDF is now available on the official SBI Careers website. Candidates appeared in the recruitment process can now easily download the result PDF and check whether their roll number is in the list of the provisionally selected candidates or not. For the convenience of the candidates, the direct link to download the SBI CBO Result 2026 PDF is provided below.

Direct Link to Download SBI CBO Result 2026 PDF

How to Download SBI CBO Result PDF?

You can now easily download the Final Result from the official SBI Careers website by just following some few steps that we have given below.

Step 1: Visit State Bank of India website.

Step 2: Click on Careers section which is there on homepage.

Step 3: Open the Current Openings section.

Step 4: Find the link where “Recruitment of Circle-Based Officers” is written.

Step 5: Click on the Final Result PDF link.

Step 6: Download the PDF and then search your Roll Number by using Ctrl + F option.

Step 7: Save and print the result PDF for future use.

Details Mentioned on the SBI Circle-Based Officer Result PDF

The SBI CBO Merit List includes all the important information which is related to the final selection of candidates. After downloading the result, you can have all the info that can be verified by the following details.

  • Candidate’s Roll Number
  • Registration Number
  • Examination Name
  • Result Status
  • Instructions for the next stage of the recruitment process

What After SBI CBO Final Merit List 2026?

The candidates whose roll numbers are included in the SBI CBO Final Merit List will now be eligible for appointment as Circle Based Officers. They will have to clear the Local Language Proficiency Test wherever applicable and go through the entire process of document verification. On completion of all formalities SBI will issue appointment letters to the selected candidates. Candidates shall keep visiting the official SBI website for updates regarding joining instructions and posting details.

SBI Circle Based Officer Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is the SBI CBO Final Result 2026 released?

Ans. Yes, the SBI CBO Final Result is released on 24th July 2026.

Q2. How can I download the SBI CBO Merit List PDF 2026?

Ans. You can easily download the PDF from the SBI Careers website which is provided in our article.

Q3. How many vacancies are announced under SBI CBO Recruitment 2026?

Ans. Recruitment has been done for 2,273 vacancies of Circle Based Officer.

Q4. What details are mentioned in the SBI Circle-Based Officer Result PDF?

Ans. The PDF includes all the roll number, registration number, result status, examination name, etc.

Q5. What happens after the SBI CBO Final Merit List 2026?

Ans. The selected candidates have to appear for Local Language Proficiency Test, document verification and appointment.
